## Answers

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` (re-presigns expiring S3 attachment URLs so stored `s3_object` presign links stay fresh) — every 12 h (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`; loop at `:29-41`, work at `RunOnce`→`CheckAndPresign` `:43-47`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed and run once immediately at `server/server.go:162-163`, then started as a goroutine at `server/server.go:166-171`.

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual HTTP send at `:152`, `safeClient.Do(req)`); enqueued asynchronously by `PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:145-158`.
Protection: two layers — (a) dial-time SSRF guard `safeDialContext` on the shared `safeClient` transport, which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs (also defeats DNS rebinding) — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:135-140, 162-180`; (b) admission-time `webhook.ValidateURL` (scheme must be http/https + resolved IPs must not be reserved) — `internal/webhook/validate.go:62-83`, with the reserved CIDR list at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23` and the `AllowPrivateIPs` escape hatch at `:38-54`. `ValidateURL` is called on webhook create/update at `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp` (`IdentityProviderUserInfo`, `internal/idp/idp.go:3-8`). Concrete protocol implementation: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2` (`IdentityProvider`, `NewIdentityProvider`, `ExchangeToken`, `UserInfo` — `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19-26,44,83`). It is the only one shipped; consumed at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:13`.

**h04** — No. `mysql.NewDB` appears exactly once in the whole repo, inside the factory `db.NewDBDriver` (`store/db/db.go:22`), and `store/db/mysql` is imported by exactly one file, `store/db/db.go:8` (`grep -rn "db/mysql\"" --include=*.go .` → one hit; `grep -rn "mysql\.NewDB"` → one hit). Every other construction site, including tests, goes through the factory (`store/test/store.go:28,50`, `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go:70`).

**h05** — Explicit Go code, in a transaction; there is no database-level rule.
- Explicit deletes (two statements per driver: reactions on the user's memo tree by `content_id`, then reactions authored by the user by `creator_id`): `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102` with implementations at `:380-388` and `:400-403`; same in `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102,417,437` and `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102,380,400`.
- Absence of a DB rule: the `reaction` table is declared with no foreign keys and no `ON DELETE` clause in any dialect — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98` (and the original `store/migration/*/0.20/00__reaction.sql`). The only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schema is on `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`).

**h06** — Handlers (all on `APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `:513`
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `:119`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`

Convergence: all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:43,71`) into the queue, and delivery executes in the single function `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07** —
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` (route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (registered at `:124`)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` only when finding by ID)
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers`
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (driver impl; sqlite by default) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (`store/db/mysql/user.go:84`, `store/db/postgres/user.go:87`)
- Bytes then come from `user.AvatarURL` (a data URI), decoded by `parseDataURI` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737`, served at `:209`. The URL itself is produced by the converter `server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`.

**h08** — Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked? **yes** — `server/server.go:163` (and internally by `Runner.Run` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? **no** — no caller anywhere (no test file exists in that package either); only the package-level `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`

**h09** — 6 concrete non-test method declarations (8 counting two test-only helpers), plus 2 interface declarations:
- `*SSEHub.Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`
- `*Store.Close` — `store/store.go:72`
- `*Cache.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187`
- `*sqlite.DB.Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`
- `*mysql.DB.Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`
- `*postgres.DB.Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`
- test-only: `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`; interface decls: `store/driver.go:12` (`Driver`), `store/cache/cache.go:31` (`cache.Interface`)

Invoked from non-test server code:
- `*Store.Close` ← `server/server.go:146` (`Server.Shutdown`)
- `*SSEHub.Close` ← `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `*Cache.Close` ← `store/store.go:74-76` (three caches)
- the driver `Close` (sqlite/mysql/postgres, dispatched through `Driver`) ← `store/store.go:78`

**h10** — `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — ~28 call sites (all within `internal/filter/render.go`; confirmed by graph fan-in count of 28 non-test callers and 28 textual call sites). Runner-up among non-test callers: `(*markdownRenderer).renderChildren` — `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go` (~14). (If test callers are counted, `filter.NewEngine` at `internal/filter/engine.go:24` leads with 32.)

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` — referenced from 7 packages outside `store/` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`; ~93 references). 2nd: `store.Memo` — 6 packages (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`; ~64 references). Next is `store.Attachment` at 4.

**h12** — Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (the `INSERT INTO \`memo\` …` statement is built at `:41` and executed at `:42`).
Determination: the driver is selected at startup from `profile.Driver`, whose default is `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` `viper.SetDefault("driver","sqlite")` and the flag default at `:130`); that profile feeds `db.NewDBDriver` (`cmd/memos/main.go:57`), whose `switch profile.Driver` picks `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/db.go:18-20`). The resulting `store.Driver` is stored in `Store` (`cmd/memos/main.go:64`), and `Store.CreateMemo` delegates straight to `s.driver.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:113`). So of the three `CreateMemo` implementations (sqlite/mysql/postgres), only the sqlite one runs by default.

**h13** — Implementation: the unexported `*markdown.service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (the only type implementing `markdown.Service`, declared at `:31-55`; `ExtractAll` at `:356` is the sole implementation).
Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in production exactly once, in `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` (with `WithTagExtension` + `WithMentionExtension`); also in the test helper `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`.
Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected from the APIV1 instance at `server/server.go:85`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`); `RebuildMemoPayload` also takes it as a parameter (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `MarkdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`) and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
Triggers: `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`; `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field mask path is updated — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (writing both `update.Content` and `update.Payload`); plus the bulk backfill `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` (declared but never invoked, see h08).
Extracted properties: `Tags` (list of `#tags`) and `Property` = `MemoPayload_Property{HasLink, HasTaskList, HasCode, HasIncompleteTasks, Title}` — `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`, computed in `(*service).ExtractProperties` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:193-240` (`Title` from a leading H1 at `:207-213`).

**h15** — Distinct enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (single-memo read: archived + non-public gate) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68`
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility scoping of the query — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` (parent-memo private check) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- Reaction service (list/upsert gates) — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-38` and `:83`
- Attachment service (attachment-to-memo access) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-451`; memo-attachment listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-222`
- HTTP file server `checkAttachmentPermission` (public + anonymous policy, share-token fallback, private check) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`, `:699`
- SSE delivery filter `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-144`
- RSS feeds hard-filtered to `store.Public` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Frontend sitemap hard-filtered to `store.Public` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- User stats/activity queries — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90`, `:218-220`
- Notification/mention targeting (private/protected suppression) — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62-84`, `server/notification/email.go:313-316`

**r01** — Premise incorrect: there is no Redis anywhere in this codebase (zero matches for `redis` in Go sources and in `go.sum`). Caching is an in-process, in-memory implementation: `store/cache` (`cache.Interface` at `store/cache/cache.go:11-32`, `Cache` with a background cleanup goroutine, `Close` at `:187`). The store creates three of them — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` — with `cache.Config{DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute, CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute, MaxItems: 1000}` at `store/store.go:40-53`. So user entries expire after **10 minutes** (the shared default TTL; `cache.DefaultConfig()` at `store/cache/cache.go:56-60` uses the same values). User entries are also invalidated explicitly on delete (`store/user_delete.go:39-47`).

**r02** — Premise incorrect: there is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware in this codebase. The only middleware registered on the Echo server is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware — `server/server.go:51-52`; the API v1 chain adds only authentication/authorization (`gatewayAuthMiddleware` / Connect interceptor built on `NewAuthorizer`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65-80`). A repo-wide grep for `ratelimit`/`limiter`/`throttle` finds no rate limiter — the only concurrency controls are `golang.org/x/sync/semaphore` guards on thumbnail and image processing (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:107,116,448`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:59-60`), which cap concurrent CPU work, not per-user request rates.

**r03** — Premise incorrect: no nightly database-cleanup job is scheduled, and the cron scheduler is not wired into the server at all. `internal/scheduler` is a standalone, unused library (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`); grepping for `scheduler.` outside that package returns no production usage. The `"0 2 * * *" // 2 AM daily` "daily-cleanup" string exists only as illustration in the package doc comment (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:15-21`), not as a registered job. The only real background work is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker (see h01).

**r04** — Premise incorrect: there is no message broker — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ appears in the codebase or `go.sum`, and no queue is declared in any broker. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel: `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:142` — consumed by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:145-158`), each calling `Post` (`:120`). Producers use `PostAsync` (`:184`), which drops the payload with a warning if the buffer is full (`:192-197`); the queue is therefore non-durable and lost on restart.

**r05** — Premise incorrect: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server in this project (zero matches for `graphql` in Go sources, `go.sum`, or the web frontend). The public API is Protobuf/gRPC-defined and served over Connect RPC plus a gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON transcoding layer: service definitions in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`), generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1`, registered by `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65`. Additional non-gRPC surfaces: the HTTP file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:122-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), an MCP endpoint (`server/router/mcp`, wired at `server/server.go:92-96`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:67`).
